message:
Plan A is drafted. I haven't saved or registered anything.

**Plan A (13 credits, feasible)**
- CS3650 Computer Systems, section 01 (CRN 91010): Tue/Thu 9:50–11:30
- CS3651 Lab, section 01 (CRN 91020): Fri 9:00–10:40
- ENGW3302 Advanced Writing (CRN 91030): Mon/Wed 10:30–11:50. This is your protected section.
- PSYC1101 Foundations of Psychology (CRN 91040): Tue/Thu 3:50–5:30 PM

**Tradeoff:** This plan doesn't meet your Tuesday/Thursday preference. CS3650 section 01 meets before noon on both days. I couldn't find a way to avoid that for your required course:
- **CS3650 section 02 (91011)** meets Tue/Thu 2:00–3:40 PM. It needs lab section 02 (91021), which meets Wed 12:00–1:10 PM. That overlaps your Wednesday work shift, which starts at 1:00 PM.
- **Honors section 03 (91012)** meets Tue/Thu 12:00–1:40 PM. It requires MATH2800, which isn't on your completed list.

I treated your work hours as fixed and the Tuesday/Thursday request as a preference. So I chose the only conflict-free option for CS3650.

The plan has 13 credits, which is within your 12–18 range. PSYC1101 is an elective I picked because it meets in the afternoon. I can swap it for another course.

If you can shift your Wednesday shift by about 10 minutes, or skip the first 10 minutes of the lab, I can draft a version with sections 91011 and 91021. That version has no Tuesday/Thursday classes before noon. Do you want me to draft it?
